a notice that it is no longer compliant with NYSE American’s stockholders’ equity requirements.
The company reported a $248.2M stockholders’ deficit as of June 30, 2026, alongside net losses in each of its last three fiscal years.
Southland must submit a compliance plan by October 23, 2026, outlining steps to regain compliance by March 23, 2028.
If the plan is not submitted or accepted, delisting proceedings may begin, while failure to regain compliance by March 23, 2028, could also trigger delisting proceedings.

title: Southland Holdings receives NYSE American compliance notice
